question: How many apples are there if you have 3 groups of 2 apples each?

hint.en: 💡 Think of 3 baskets. Each basket has 2 apples. Count all the apples together.
hint.hi: 💡 सोचो 3 टोकरियाँ हैं। हर टोकरी में 2 सेब हैं। सभी सेब गिनो।

example.en:
🌾 Example: 3 groups × 2 apples = ? 
Count: 2, 4, 6 — so the answer is 6.
example.hi:
🌾 उदाहरण: 3 समूह × 2 सेब = ? 
गिनो: 2, 4, 6 — तो जवाब है 6।

question: Raju had 14 rotis. He made 9 more. How many rotis does he have now?

hint.en: 💡 Raju started with some rotis and made more. Add the two numbers together.
hint.hi: 💡 राजू के पास पहले से कुछ रोटियाँ थीं और उसने और बनाईं। दोनों संख्याएँ जोड़ो।

example.en:
🌾 14 rotis + 9 rotis = ?
Count on from 14: 15, 16 … 23. So 14 + 9 = 23.

question: A farmer had 20 mangoes. He sold 8. How many mangoes are left?

hint.en: 💡 The farmer sold some mangoes — that means take away. Subtract the sold mangoes from the total.
hint.hi: 💡 किसान ने कुछ आम बेचे — मतलब घटाना है। बेचे हुए आम कुल से घटाओ।

example.en:
🌾 20 mangoes − 8 sold = ?
Count back from 20: 19, 18 … 12. So 20 − 8 = 12.

question: A market stall has 4 rows of vegetables with 6 vegetables in each row. How many vegetables are there in total?

hint.en: 💡 Each row has the same number of vegetables. Multiply rows × vegetables per row.
hint.hi: 💡 हर कतार में सब्ज़ियों की संख्या बराबर है। कतारें × हर कतार की सब्ज़ियाँ गुणा करो।

question: Priya has 18 laddoos to share equally among 3 friends. How many does each friend get?

hint.en: 💡 Sharing equally means division. Divide the total laddoos by the number of friends.
hint.hi: 💡 बराबर बाँटना मतलब भाग। कुल लड्डुओं को दोस्तों की संख्या से भाग दो।

example.en:
🌾 18 laddoos ÷ 3 friends = ?
Give 1 to each friend in turns: after 6 rounds each friend has 6.
example.hi:
🌾 18 लड्डू ÷ 3 दोस्त = ?
बारी-बारी 1-1 दो: 6 बार में हर दोस्त को 6 मिलते हैं।

question: A roti is cut into 4 equal pieces. Meena eats 1 piece. What fraction did she eat?

hint.en: 💡 A fraction shows part of a whole. Bottom number = total pieces. Top number = pieces eaten.
hint.hi: 💡 भिन्न पूरे का हिस्सा दिखाता है। नीचे = कुल टुकड़े। ऊपर = खाए हुए टुकड़े।

example.en:
🌾 Roti cut into 4 pieces. Meena eats 1.
Fraction eaten = pieces eaten / total pieces = 1/4.
example.hi:
🌾 रोटी के 4 टुकड़े। मीना ने 1 खाया।
खाया हुआ भिन्न = खाए टुकड़े / कुल टुकड़े = 1/4।

full_answer.hi: ✅ मीना ने रोटी का 1/4 हिस्सा खाया।

question: A pizza is cut into 2 equal halves. Ram eats one half. What fraction is left?

hint.en: 💡 The pizza has 2 equal parts. Ram eats 1 part. How many parts are left?
hint.hi: 💡 पिज्जा के 2 बराबर भाग हैं। राम 1 भाग खाता है। कितने भाग बचे?

example.en: 🌾 2 halves total. Ram eats 1 half. Left = 2 − 1 = 1 piece out of 2 = 1/2.

hint.en: 💡 Cut a roti into 2 pieces — each piece is big (1/2). Cut into 4 pieces — each piece is small (1/4). More cuts = smaller pieces!
hint.hi: 💡 रोटी को 2 टुकड़ों में काटो — हर टुकड़ा बड़ा (1/2)। 4 टुकड़ों में काटो — छोटे (1/4)। जितने ज़्यादा टुकड़े, उतना छोटा।

example.en:
🌾 Imagine one roti:
• Cut in 2 → each half is 1/2 (bigger piece)
• Cut in 4 → each piece is 1/4 (smaller piece)
So 1/2 > 1/4.
example.hi:
🌾 एक रोटी की कल्पना करो:
• 2 में काटो → हर हिस्सा 1/2 (बड़ा)
• 4 में काटो → हर हिस्सा 1/4 (छोटा)
इसलिए 1/2 > 1/4।

question: Sunita ate 3/4 of her roti and Rani ate 2/4. Who ate more?

hint.en: 💡 Both fractions have the same bottom number (4). Just compare the top numbers — bigger top means more eaten.
hint.hi: 💡 दोनों भिन्नों का नीचे का अंक एक जैसा है (4)। ऊपर के अंक तुलना करो — जो बड़ा है वो ज़्यादा खाया।

example.en:
🌾 Sunita: 3/4 → top number is 3
Rani: 2/4 → top number is 2
3 > 2, so Sunita ate more.
example.hi:
🌾 सुनीता: 3/4 → ऊपर का अंक 3
रानी: 2/4 → ऊपर का अंक 2
3 > 2, इसलिए सुनीता ने ज़्यादा खाया।

question: Gopal ate 1/4 of a mango and his sister ate 2/4. What fraction did they eat together?

hint.en: 💡 Both fractions have the same bottom number (4). Just add the top numbers, keep the bottom the same.
hint.hi: 💡 दोनों भिन्नों का नीचे का अंक एक जैसा (4)। बस ऊपर के अंक जोड़ो, नीचे वैसा ही रखो।

example.en:
🌾 1/4 + 2/4 = (1+2)/4 = 3/4
Like eating 1 piece of mango then 2 more — 3 pieces out of 4 total.

question: A water tank is 2/6 full in the morning. By afternoon it fills 1/6 more. How full is it now?

hint.en: 💡 Same bottom number (6). Add only the top numbers.
hint.hi: 💡 नीचे का अंक एक जैसा (6)। बस ऊपर के अंक जोड़ो।

example.en:
🌾 2/6 + 1/6 = (2+1)/6 = 3/6
Like a tank with 2 buckets of water, adding 1 more — now 3 out of 6 buckets full.

question: Noor had 3/4 of a guava. She ate 1/4. How much guava is left?

hint.en: 💡 Same bottom number (4). Subtract only the top numbers, keep the bottom the same.
hint.hi: 💡 नीचे का अंक एक जैसा (4)। बस ऊपर के अंक घटाओ, नीचे वैसा रखो।

example.en:
🌾 3/4 − 1/4 = (3−1)/4 = 2/4
Noor had 3 pieces, ate 1 — 2 pieces of guava remain.

question: A field is 5/6 planted with wheat. Cows eat 2/6 of the field. What fraction of the field still has wheat?

hint.en: 💡 Same bottom number (6). Subtract the eaten part from the planted part.
hint.hi: 💡 नीचे का अंक एक जैसा (6)। जो खाया उसे लगाए हुए हिस्से से घटाओ।

example.en:
🌾 5/6 − 2/6 = (5−2)/6 = 3/6
Field had 5 parts wheat; cows ate 2 parts — 3 parts still have wheat.

full_answer.en: ✅ 5/6 − 2/6 = 3/6 of the field still has wheat.

question: There are 12 chapatis. 1/3 of them are for the children. How many chapatis are for the children?

hint.en: 💡 '1/3 of 12' means divide 12 into 3 equal groups and take 1 group.
hint.hi: 💡 '12 का 1/3' मतलब 12 को 3 बराबर हिस्सों में बाँटो और 1 हिस्सा लो।

example.en:
🌾 12 ÷ 3 = 4 chapatis in each group.
1/3 of 12 = 1 group = 4 chapatis for the children.

question: A farmer has 20 cows. 1/4 of them are brown. How many cows are brown?

hint.en: 💡 '1/4 of 20' means divide 20 into 4 equal groups and take 1 group.
hint.hi: 💡 '20 का 1/4' मतलब 20 को 4 बराबर हिस्सों में बाँटो और 1 हिस्सा लो।

example.en:
🌾 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cows in each group.
1/4 of 20 = 1 group = 5 brown cows.
